PERSISTENT.snapshot: Digital-engineering services firm growing ~27% a year in rupees since FY22, now at a US$488m quarterly run-rate [Q2FY27 call]. Mix is led by Software/Hi-Tech (+28.5% YoY), then BFSI (+16.2%) and Healthcare (+12.0%); North America drives growth while Europe shrank 8.5% [Q2FY27 call].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: On track for ~US$2bn — later clarified as a US$500m quarterly exit run-rate, not FY27 revenue [Q3FY26 → Q4FY26 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q2FY27 revenue US$487.6m; only 1.3% QoQ needed for two quarters vs a 4.8% recent average [Q2FY27 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.note: Achievable — but the goalpost moved from annual revenue to exit run-rate.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: 16–17% EBIT margin is the aspiration; growth comes first [Q4FY26 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBIT 16.3% → 16.0% → 15.0% over three quarters; standardised EBITDA margin fell from 19.1% to 13.6% YoY [calls; quarterly table]

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Part of the 180–200 bps wage-hike hit would be recouped in Q2 [Q1FY27 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Margin fell another 100 bps in Q2; large-deal tooling/licence amortisation cost 90 bps [Q2FY27 call]

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: OCF/PAT returns to the ~100% norm during FY27 [Q1FY27 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q1 OCF/PAT 24%; but FY22–26 cumulative CFO/PAT is 101% [Q1FY27 call; cash-flow table]

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Healthcare and BFSI to lead FY27 growth [Q4FY26 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Hi-Tech grew fastest (+28.5%); Healthcare slowest (+12.0%) [Q2FY27 call]

bull: Revenue engine intact: 7.8% cc QoQ in Q2, the fastest in the series, as the US$650m deal ramps [Q2FY27 call].
Clean balance sheet before Nagarro: debt/equity 0.06, plus ~Rs 4,265 cr fresh QIP equity [BS FY26; QIP filing].
Five-year cash conversion ~101% of PAT with no negative-CFO year [cash-flow table].
bear: Margin promise slipping three quarters running; pending Nagarro adds ~US$50m one-time cost and acquisition debt [Q2FY27 call].
Q2 PAT fell 25% YoY on 30% revenue growth — growth is not reaching the bottom line [quarterly table].
Bookings soft: TCV ~US$634m vs US$1.15bn in Q1; analysts flagged ~4% YoY TCV growth [Q2FY27 call].
watch: Q3FY27 EBIT margin vs 16% — does the 90 bps amortisation drag start fading?
PERSISTENT.data_note: Screener's standardised EBITDA (13.6% in Q2) sits below the company's reported EBIT (15.0%) — the two use different cost classifications. Guidance is checked against the company's own EBIT; trends use the standardised series.

POLYCAB.generated_by: Claude (build session) from 2 transcripts + AR-derived tables
POLYCAB.snapshot: India's largest wires & cables maker, extending into fans/switches/lighting (FMEG) and power-distribution EPC [about; Q2FY27 call]. Q2FY27 growth was broad: W&C +47%, FMEG +124%, EPC +53% YoY; EPC was ~Rs 617 cr of the quarter [Q2FY27 call].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: W&C EBIT margin 11–13% over the medium term (Project Spring) [Q1FY27 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: 13.3% in Q1, 14.2% in Q2 — above the top of the band [Q1FY27, Q2FY27 calls]
narrative_vs_numbers.note: Positive divergence — and management declined to raise the band when asked.

narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FMEG EBIT already 10.1% in Q2FY27, four years early [Q2FY27 call]

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Working-capital cycle normalises to 45–50 days [Q1FY27 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Cash conversion cycle fell 77 → 39 days FY22–26 and ~11 days in Q2 as payable days jumped 64 → 108 [ratios table; Q2FY27 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.note: FY26's 141% CFO/PAT leaned on supplier credit that management itself expects to unwind.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: No near-term revenue guidance; growth depends on copper prices [Q2FY27 call]
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Revenue +53% YoY in Q2 vs +39% in Q1 — part of this is metal-price pass-through, not volume [quarterly table; calls]

bull: Operating leverage is real: EBITDA compounded 33.5% vs sales 24.0% a year FY22–26; margin +3.5 pp [P&L table].
Effectively debt-free (D/E 0.02) while funding Rs 610 cr of H1 capex internally [BS FY26; Q2FY27 call].
Every scored margin promise met or beaten — management sandbagged 2 of 3 [promise ledger].
bear: A new wires entrant pricing 10–15% lower was raised on the call; current 14% margins leave room to be competed away [Q2FY27 call].
FY26 cash flow was flattered by payables; a return to 45–50 day cycles reverses that [ratios table; Q1FY27 call].
Exports ~5% of revenue vs a >10% FY30 target — the diversification lever hasn't started [Q2FY27 call].
watch: W&C margin vs 13% if the new entrant forces price cuts
Payable days / cash cycle in the H1 balance sheet
EPC margin after falling from 11% to 7.2% in a quarter
